verdict.rationale: Foreloop's own docs say it serves MCP at a first-party endpoint (/api/app/public/v1/mcp) over streamable HTTP, and any MCP client can connect with only that URL and an API key. Per-integration keys are created under Settings → Connections. Missing for 10: documentation of which tools and resources the MCP server exposes, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP connection works.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Foreloop speaks MCP at /api/app/public/v1/mcp over streamable HTTP. An MCP client needs that URL and an API key and nothing else.
Create keys in Settings, under Connections, then API keys. Give every integration its own key, so revoking one does not take down the others.
